planets.name: HAT-P-17 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-17 with a 10.3-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: HAT-P-17 b was found in 2012 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HAT-P-17. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 10.33853522, pl_radj 1.05, pl_bmassj 0.58

quotes.title: HAT-P-17
quotes.card: It is the host of two planets, HAT-P-17b and HAT-P-17c, both discovered in 2010.
quotes.introduction: A search for a binary companion star using adaptive optics at the MMT Observatory was negative.
